test_title: PYST 31: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people B, C, D, I, J, K, and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only three people sit between D and L, when counted from the right of L. Only three people sit between K and I, when counted from the left of K. B sits to the immediate right of D. J is an immediate neighbour of L as well as I. Who sits second to the left of C?
solution:
Seven people B, C, D, I, J, K, and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1. Only three people sit between D and L, when counted from the right of L.

2. Only three people sit between K and I, when counted from the left of K.

3. B sits to the immediate right of D.

4. J is an immediate neighbour of L as well as I. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf7aafe172ec0ad9e4c14c9a058a8800fa87c9aa15a363986f9d92ec044e777a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e18fe4dfa6423a8c5dc14ae0ff627621654e2eb02a9a1989ceb05914a057026.png] 

J sits second to the left of C.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 1**”.
